message.lsmmod.awning.support_only: Right-click an awning support to attach the awning.
message.lsmmod.awning.incomplete: The support must be complete and both supports must have the same width.
message.lsmmod.awning.occupied: One of the supports already holds an awning.
message.lsmmod.awning.no_partner: A parallel aligned support is required: up to 48 clear blocks and at most one block of height difference.
message.lsmmod.awning.blocked: The entire awning needs clear space.
message.lsmmod.awning.unloaded: The whole awning area must be loaded and within the world.
message.lsmmod.awning.permission: You cannot place an awning here.
message.lsmmod.awning.width: Support width: %s blocks (Shift + right-click to change).
